title: Evaluation of prompt-gamma imaging for range verification for the proton irradiation of tumor patients
summary: This study is addressed to patients who receive a proton therapy as part of their oncological treatment. Aim of the study is the detection of the range of the proton in the patient and the evaluation of the novel method of prompt gamma imaging.
conditions: All oncological diseases with indication for proton therapy.

interventions.name: The prompt gamma radiation will be detected by the prompt gamma camera in patients who are irradiated with protons.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indications for proton therapy
Exclusion criteria:
No indications for proton therapy
